metadata.description:
In this episode of Tribal Kitchen, Shyam Sunder brings a rare forest delicacy from Satpuda, Maharashtra.
Cooked using the Dumkha flower and prepared in the traditional tabla cooking style, this dish uses zero oil and no masala. Rich in nutrition, it is good for the heart and helps fight anemia, yet the taste is truly outstanding.
Watch Devyani and Heena cook this authentic tribal forest recipe with us.
